optimizedContext.value:
# FS Spec Repository
## Rules
- FsSpecRepository validates config path/metadataPath only; both directories required. Factory forwards context/config unchanged.
- FsSpecIndexCache owns list/count/reindex/invalidation under config tmp fs-cache; no direct index files. Capability path sort; invalidation/source-file mtime freshness, no TTL.
- Index caches workspace/path/title/summary/meta stamps; title metadata else final path. Projection errors swallowed; list flags read cache only; Meta never hash.
- get uses stats only for artifact, lock, metadata stamps.
- read/writePersistedState share canonical stable atomic spec-lock serializer with publish; validate complete state, exact-byte hashes, expectedRevision conflicts; no invented defaults; readOnly rejects before I/O.
- New publish needs artifacts. Rename EPERM/EBUSY/EACCES bounded retry; normalize line endings only temporary gitignore equality.
- Metadata snapshots return missing/invalid/present, enforce revisions, may write readOnly workspace. artifactMeta reuses stat/hash path.
- Persisted/generated meta optional hash, null absent. specFingerprint hashes filename-sorted artifacts + lock hash/absent sentinel; exclude metadata. No validation cache ownership.
## Constraints
- infrastructure/fs implementation of SpecRepository; never owns schema/patch/default selection.
